question: Identify an endoparasite found in animals.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flatworms.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **endoparasite** is a parasite that **lives inside the body** of its host.
 
• It may reside in the **digestive tract, blood vessels**, or other organs of the host animal.
 
• **Flatworms** are a type of endoparasite that can be found in a variety of** animals, including humans.**
 
• They are also known as** tapeworms or flukes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pleurobrachia and Ctenoplana** are both **marine animals** that belong to the **phylum Ctenophora**, also known as **comb jellies.**

 
 
• They are **carnivorous** and feed on **small planktonic animals.**
 
 
 
• **Adamsia** is a type of **sea anemone **that lives in symbiosis with certain species of **hermit crabs**.
 
 
• The crab provides protection for the** anemone,** while the anemone provides a source of **food for the crab.**
